_about: s08c Cook measures, written by build/tools/art/specs/s08c-cook-post.py (the code keeps its own copies of the numbers it uses)

bowls._about: the kadchi: its bowl's biggest inner circle (cx, cy, r of w) and the handle's direction from it (deg, y down); the teaspoon: its bowl's centre and its length, of w

brew._about: CP4: each picture's rim circle (cx, cy, rim) and its contents' circle (inner), source px (Hough)

hob._about: the hob plate cut from bg-cook-hob-t-v1.png (src_box, source px, its rounded mask's corner radius) x2; in1600: its box in the 1600x900 design box, where bg-cook-hob-t-v1-1600 drew it (the stations' burners, station-lib.js BURNER)

marble._about: WT1 cut from its source, cross-faded left-right and top-bottom, upscaled x2: laid tiled at 0.5 design px per source px (js/cook/stations.js fitBg)

tip._about: CP3 cells 1-4 (pan-tip-<deg>-s08c, one window 484x406): the contents' centre (cx, cy), the rim's half width rx and half height ry, and the near rim's middle (lip: the stream leaves from it), source px

tray._about: SK4 tray-4-s08c (w x h px): the tray's top and bottom rows (tray), and each skewer [x, tip, handle, end] as fractions of w and h (V3.rack's form); tray-n holds skewers 1..n (from the left)
